options.formula:
IF(
    AND(
        OR(
            LEN(ARRAYJOIN({fldfgNcT03v4TZrNE}, ",")) = 0,
            SUBSTITUTE(
                SUBSTITUTE(
                    SUBSTITUTE(
                        ARRAYJOIN({fldfgNcT03v4TZrNE}, ","),
                        "Approved",
                        ""
                    ),
                    ",",
                    ""
                ),
                " ",
                ""
            ) = ""
        ),

        {fldYpIwi0DcgVAjSB} = "Completed",

        {fld1sTdXmRO5ZNTik} = "Ready",

        {fldGu1onl7NMJ4Ay2} = "Not Created",

        {fldBXKfp45g990C6n} != BLANK(),

        LEN(TRIM({fld5T069KEywPp5F4} & "")) > 0,

        LEN(TRIM({fldJKbExQdoLlV13V} & "")) > 0,

        LEN(TRIM({fldR3PaaTo9BIjmSO} & "")) > 0
    ),

    "All good, you can Approved the invoice.",

    TRIM(
        IF(
            AND(
                {fldfgNcT03v4TZrNE},
                SUBSTITUTE(
                    SUBSTITUTE(
                        SUBSTITUTE(
                            ARRAYJOIN({fldfgNcT03v4TZrNE}, ","),
                            "Approved",
                            ""
                        ),
                        ",",
                        ""
                    ),
                    " ",
                    ""
                ) != ""
            ),
            "Please make sure to approve all the back charges of this project." & "\n",
            ""
        ) &

        IF(
            {fldYpIwi0DcgVAjSB} != "Completed",
            "Please wait for the project to complete." & "\n",
            ""
        ) &

        IF(
            {fld1sTdXmRO5ZNTik} != "Ready",
            "Please make sure that your report status is Ready." & "\n",
            ""
        ) &

        IF(
            {fldGu1onl7NMJ4Ay2} != "Not Created",
            "The final invoice has already been created or is not in Not Created status." & "\n",
            ""
        ) &

        IF(
            {fldBXKfp45g990C6n} = BLANK(),
            "Please make sure the Approved Proposal Amount is available." & "\n",
            ""
        ) &

        IF(
            LEN(TRIM({fld5T069KEywPp5F4} & "")) = 0,
            "Please make sure the Customer Name is available." & "\n",
            ""
        ) &

        IF(
            LEN(TRIM({fldJKbExQdoLlV13V} & "")) = 0,
            "Please make sure the Contact email is available." & "\n",
            ""
        ) &

        IF(
            LEN(TRIM({fldR3PaaTo9BIjmSO} & "")) = 0,
            "Please make sure the Product Type is available." & "\n",
            ""
        )
    )
)
